description: COSMORA is a team of passionate young innovators exploring Earth science, space technology, and AI. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we are taking on The Earth Information Jukebox, transforming NASA Earth data into interactive visualizations and sound. We welcome creative and motivated people with skills in coding, web development, AI, data science, audio engineering, design, and Earth science. No expert experience required—just curiosity, creativity, and teamwork!
